scope: Old Government House at the University of Auckland as represented by the 2008 exterior reference, including the lawn façade, attached wings, open inner court and mapped northeast portico. The neighboring university clock tower, gatekeeper cottage, lawns and interiors are outside this asset.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The university dates the mansion to 1856 and identifies its timber façade, scored to resemble masonry.
The heritage listing identifies the northeast portico as an 1890 addition and records later conservation changes.
